topic: compass/invariant — writes must go through oracle.propose(), never oracle.commit()
decision: All Compass-generated Chronicle entries must use oracle.propose() and wait for human commit(). Compass must never call oracle.commit() autonomously.
key_insight: Compass must only stage Chronicle entries via oracle.propose() — never commit autonomously.
rejected_reason: Auto-commit bypasses the human gate that is the core safety property of Chronicle
